profile.summary: Fremont Adult and Continuing Education (FACE) is the adult school of the Fremont Unified School District in Fremont, California. It offers language learning, secondary education, college pathways, job training, technology and career skills, civics and citizenship, and lifelong learning classes for adults.

review.notes: CareerWork$ release names Fremont Adult and Continuing Education (a Fremont Unified adult school at 4700 Calaveras Ave) as BankWork$ partner with Oakland Adult and Continuing Education, matching OUSD's BankWork$ no-cost agreements. Name, address, phone, website and org type are confirmed by the cited pages; the summary's offerings list is slightly broader than the cited pages (college pathways, technology are not shown) but the core description is supported and neutral.
